threshold_note: Approximate two-decimal displayed-rate rounding; sensitivity around this convention is smaller than regime uncertainty. Only actual published 5 Yr>=5.10 qualifies.
probability_basis: Primary subjective regime mixture with vol near observed5–6bp daily moves. Zero/positive/negative future drifts and weights are deliberately assumed, not estimated transition probabilities. September Fed hike and October14 energy-led CPI support renewed inflation branch; weak payrolls and recent yield retreat support easing branch. Avoid mechanically extrapolating the40-day1.35bp/day trend.
limitations: One source vintage, no revision history; iid Gaussian daily shocks with piecewise fixed regime, no stochastic volatility or calibrated event jumps, approximate51-day calendar/rounding. Range and reserve are judgment sensitivities, not confidence intervals/bounds. No off-chain Treasury trade contemplated; this is an on-chain exact named-source condition.
